intentAndPurpose.intent: Transient status feedback with semantic type, independent visual attention and announcement priority, optional action content, progress, stacking, dedupe, and promise lifecycle.

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to two action nodes. Structured descriptors additionally support managed auto-close.

props.name: actionsPlacement
props.description: Whether actions sit beside (`end`, max 1 structured) or below (`bottom`, max 2, trailing-aligned).

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether the dismiss control is visible.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Optional help/status line rendered below the progress track (Figma `helpText`). Only rendered when the progress bar is visible (`type="default"` and `progress` is set). Independent of `description`. Empty/null renders nothing; ignored when progress is hidden.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Display-only Toast callback. Managed ToastItem instances close through their manager.

props.name: progress
props.description: Optional determinate percentage or indeterminate progress. Figma (15107:2861): only rendered when `type="default"`.

props.name: start
props.description: Leading visual. `false` hides the type-derived default visual.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Auto-dismiss timeout when published through a manager. Defaults to 3000ms; zero is persistent.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary message. A description-only toast is valid.
